arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Yun Jin from Genshin Impact expressing confusion. The supplied explicitly approved neutral is the SOLE image reference. Preserve its exact recognizable identity, face, skin tone, hair and eye colors, normal pupils, costume construction, accessories, proportions and detailed anime illustration style. In particular preserve its dark indigo hair and fringe, reddish-pink eyes and makeup, pom-pom opera headdress and tassels, white fur collar, pink shoulder panels, exact patterned purple dress, pale front panel, red tassels, tights and decorated boots.
Build: keep the approved neutral's petite Medium Female proportions and body type. Maintain the same compactness without lengthening the torso or legs or stretching anatomy to fill the canvas.
Personality: graceful, warm and expressive, with an opera performer’s poised trained gestures. Acting for this emotion: A poised puzzled look with one brow raised and open eyes glancing slightly aside. Tilt her head thoughtfully. Lift her right hand beside her cheek in an elegant, loosely open questioning gesture, with a visible gap of transparent background between the hand and her cheek, collar and headdress; the hand does not touch fabric. Let her left arm relax beside the skirt, the left hand slightly away from its hem. Preserve her trained opera poise. Change the whole pose and body language for this emotion rather than only changing the face or mechanically copying the neutral.
Hand rendering: build each hand around one softly shaped palm, with four fingers flowing from its upper edge and a shorter opposable thumb joining its side. Together these form the five natural digits of a human hand. Let the fingers follow a gentle relaxed arc, with believable knuckles and smooth bends; the thumb has its own readable shape. In these open gestures, make the silhouette of each hand clear and complete, viewed mostly in the image plane. Keep a small visible gap between the hands and nearby sleeves, chest or clothing so the skin contours end cleanly rather than blending into fabric. Exactly two arms, two legs and two feet, with feet clearly distinct and uncrossed. Costume markings must follow the surfaces they belong to and turn in perspective with the body. Let hair and heavy costume panels follow the pose naturally with gravity. Preserve the established outfit fully. Use ordinary pupils; no heart pupils or floating hearts.
Complete silhouette including headwear, hair, hands, accessories, costume panels and shoes, with about 2–4% top and bottom padding and 92–96% visible height. Genuinely transparent background with clear alpha outside the character; no scenery, backdrop, vignette, glow, floor, ground shadow, reflections, floating effects, text, labels, UI, watermark, added props, weapons or additional characters.
